# React Router downstream suite

[React Router](https://github.com/remix-run/react-router)'s `packages/react-router` tests (Jest in native ESM mode, 119 files), unmodified, on jsdom and on @ctrl/dom.

## Run

```sh
pnpm downstream:react-router --install     # first run: clone the pinned commit and install its dependencies
pnpm downstream:react-router --preset all  # what the results below track
```

Presets: `smoke` (4 files) and `all` (what the results track).
